title: Construction and optimization of organic fluorophores in NIR-II fluorescence imaging
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00063G, Review Article
Xiaozhen Li, Yanlong Yang, Ruohan Zhang, Wei Huang
This review comprehensively summarizes recent progress in second near-infrared fluorescence imaging (NIR-II FLI) by highlighting an increasingly developing palette of biocompatible organic fluorophores (OFs) with tunable NIR-II emission wavelengths.
